verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's own docs describe budgets that track actual spend against planned spend, budget notifications, and programmatic cost-control responses through Pub/Sub, which covers the budgets-and-alerts core of the story. Nothing in the pack documents anomaly detection on spend, which is an explicit part of the story. Missing for 10: documented spend anomaly detection, evidence that budgets and alerts are configurable from day one by default, independent or hands-on corroboration that alerts prevent surprise bills.

support.subject: As a founder, the bill cannot silently explode — budgets, alerts, and documented anomaly detection on spend, configurable from day one

citations.quote: A budget enables you to track your actual Google Cloud spend against your planned spend.
